title: Case 050: Estimator Contact for a Property Claim
initial_request: I own the property at 150 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 5ZZ. Northmere Insurance has asked for the estimator's contact, and I need help confirming what contact can be shared and making sure it is limited to this claim.
overview: Northmere Insurance asked Firbank Cover agent Sky Morgan to obtain the estimator Martin Clark's work contact for questions about the repair estimate already recorded on claim CLM-050. Sky checked with Lauren Davis for Martin's protected-portal work handle contractor/EST-050 and permission to share it. After Lauren confirmed Martin had agreed to sharing his work contact for this claim, Sky sent only that fictional protected-portal handle through a protected channel. Northmere Insurance confirmed receipt; no decision on the estimate was recorded.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, confirm Martin Clark's current work contact and permission to share it with Northmere Insurance for this claim, and disclose only his work contact—not a personal number.

outcome: Northmere Insurance confirmed that it received Martin Clark's work contact; no decision on the estimate is recorded.

events.from: Rowan Patel, Northmere Insurance claims handler
events.body: The repair estimate is already recorded under claim CLM-050, and I need to clarify a few points with its author. Please obtain Martin Clark's appropriate work contact; we do not need his personal number.

Martin has confirmed that you may share his work contact with Northmere Insurance for this claim. Martin has enabled his work messaging handle contractor/EST-050 in the shared protected claims portal; the assigned Northmere handler can message him through that handle for CLM-050. Please use that route only, not his personal number.

Lauren confirmed Martin's permission to share his work contact with Northmere Insurance for CLM-050. I will pass only his fictional protected-portal work handle contractor/EST-050 to the assigned handler, not a personal contact.
